tools.name: replicate_run
tools.description: Run any Replicate-hosted model (image or video generation, upscalers, etc.). Creates a prediction, polls until it succeeds or fails, and returns the output media URL(s).

model.description: Replicate model identifier: 'owner/name' (latest version), 'owner/name:version' (pinned), or a bare 64-hex version hash. E.g. 'black-forest-labs/flux-schnell'.

input.description: Model-specific input parameters passed through to Replicate (e.g. prompt, aspect_ratio, num_outputs, image, seed). The prompt key varies by model; most use 'prompt'.

wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to poll for completion (default 120, max 600). Increase for long video jobs.
